commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to an anemic score of 28, India VIX surging 12.5%, and the Nifty slicing through critical support amid macro shocks, Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil demand absolute defensive discipline. In CANSLIM, the 'M' (Market Direction) rules supreme: three out of four stocks mirror the broad tape during corrections. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure dictates holding cash as an active position, avoiding premature longs, and curtailing position sizing. While select elite growth names like ARROWGREEN and AHCL demonstrate remarkable relative strength, new breakouts face a heightened risk of failure. Capital preservation is priority one—wait for follow-through confirmation before deploying aggressive risk.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis, Darvas Box & Livermore Tape Reading

ACE.technical: Meets Minervini Trend Template: price sits comfortably above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Forms a compact double-bottom consolidation with a pivot trigger at ₹1269.27. Volume contraction in the 5.6% handle signals supply drying up, while relative strength remains resilient against broad market weakness.
ACE.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 20.5% YoY to ₹785.7 Cr with net profit expanding 22.3% to ₹119.5 Cr. Backed by solid 15% OPM, healthy ROCE exceeding 38%, ROE of 27.7%, and an effectively debt-free balance sheet with 65.4% promoter ownership.
ACE.risk: A close below the swing handle low at ₹1188.57 breaches structure; exit immediately to preserve capital against general market drag.

AEGISVOPAK.technical: While trading above major averages, the stock triggered Jesse Livermore's classic danger signal by poking above its ₹321.27 pivot and immediately failing. Lacks clean VCP contraction, and fragile overhead supply threatens a bull trap during general market distribution.
AEGISVOPAK.fundamental: Q1 FY27 net profit contracted 11.9% YoY to ₹69.4 Cr despite 12.4% revenue growth, illustrating margin compression. Rich P/E multiple (~120x) paired with modest ROCE (~7.6%) and lagging bottom-line momentum disqualify it under CANSLIM parameters.
AEGISVOPAK.risk: Violation of ₹290.68 confirms a failed breakout; disciplined stop execution is mandatory to prevent holding through a Stage 3 distribution phase.

AETHER.technical: Textbook Stage 2 structure holding well above rising EMA21, 50-day, and 200-day SMAs. A constructive double bottom base with neckline pivot at ₹1799.80 shows healthy accumulation. RSI 64 and bullish MACD confirm underlying accumulation, showing notable relative strength while benchmark indices correct.
AETHER.fundamental: Q1 FY27 net profit surged 33.5% YoY to ₹62.75 Cr on a 27.3% revenue jump to ₹326.6 Cr. Robust operating margins of 31.5% reflect proprietary specialty chemistry pricing power. Virtually debt-free balance sheet with stable 74.9% promoter holding.
AETHER.risk: Breakdown below ₹1670.91 invalidates the right side of the base; cut losses instantly in accordance with Minervini risk limits.

AHCL.technical: Power breakout to fresh 52-week highs at ₹34.69, clearing a 20-day base on heavy volume. Price rides well above rising 21 EMA and 50/200 SMAs. Positive MACD divergence and stellar relative strength highlight a speculative leader decoupling from market headwinds.
AHCL.fundamental: Explosive Q1 FY27 results show revenue expanding 163% YoY to ₹87.6 Cr and PAT leaping 87.6% YoY to ₹8.28 Cr. Low debt-to-equity (~0.19), healthy operating margins (~26%), and unpledged 70.3% promoter stake provide strong fundamental fuel.
AHCL.risk: Decisive close below the base breakout level at ₹29.38 aborts the momentum thesis; enforce an uncompromising stop to protect capital.

AONELIQUID.technical: Scanner anomaly: the instrument is a 1D rate cash-management ETF tracking overnight repo rates. Technical chart patterns like moving average alignments and 20-day breakouts are artificial artifacts of daily NAV interest accrual, completely devoid of institutional equity accumulation or true relative strength.
AONELIQUID.risk: Cash equivalent with negligible volatility; zero equity reward potential. Stop at ₹1079.22 is irrelevant—avoid as an equity growth trade.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Exceptional Stage 2 leader carving a high-handle double bottom near all-time highs. Cleared neckline at ₹953.70 with strong price-volume characteristics. RSI at 65 and expanding MACD show strong momentum, demonstrating textbook relative strength and institutional accumulation against a declining benchmark.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Classic CANSLIM profile: Q1 FY27 revenue doubled (+111% YoY to ₹87.8 Cr) while net profit surged 151% to ₹27.4 Cr. Boasts outstanding ROCE of 29.6%, net margins above 25%, zero debt, and zero promoter pledge.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Failure below ₹856.75 breaches base support; exit ruthlessly to protect profits and mitigate overall market contagion risk.
